key_highlights: ASX slumped as bond yields spiked and unemployment hit a 5-year high, with RBA signalling further rate hikes despite labour market deterioration
AUD/USD weakened sharply ('pulverised') amid US economic outperformance and Trump-related trade policy uncertainty
Trump diesel export ban poses direct threat to Australian energy security and fuel costs as global buffers dry up
Intergenerational Report 2026 flags structural fiscal pressure, reinforcing case for tax reform
Property market softening: rising listings, falling demand, and prices declining; construction stress at Bathla with lenders withdrawing
Mining exploration positive: Rio2 Peruvian copper drill, Auric gold discovery at Munda, Forrestania British Hill gold resource >210,000 oz, Sarytogan 452m copper intercept
Jetstar industrial action escalates with staff waiving fees; Nine leadership reshuffle; Financial Review editor departs

sectors.trend: Exploration activity robust across copper and gold; Rio2 Peruvian drill assault, Auric high-grade gold at Munda, Forrestania British Hill >210k oz, Sarytogan 452m copper, Lindian rare earths nearing production. However, macro headwinds from AUD weakness and global demand uncertainty temper sentiment.
sectors.implications: Exploration-stage names (Aureka, Manhattan, Vista Gold) offer asymmetric upside; major miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) face mixed signals from copper strength vs. iron ore demand concerns. Rare earths (Lindian) benefit from supply-chain diversification themes.

sectors.trend: RBA hiking into a deteriorating labour market (unemployment 5-year high) creates credit risk overhang. Bond yield spike pressures bank NIMs. Intergenerational Report flags fiscal stress. Construction lending stress at Bathla signals emerging NPL risk in property finance.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin compression from yield curve inversion risk and rising provisions. REITs under pressure from higher discount rates. Monitor ASX 200 Financials index closely.

sectors.trend: Fuel price fears intensify as global buffers dry up; Trump diesel export ban threatens Australian supply. Political debate over energy costs (Labor vs Coalition) adds policy uncertainty. Nuclear energy debate resurfaces.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WDL.AX, SXG.AX face input cost pressure. Energy policy uncertainty deters capex. LNG exporters (BHP.AX, WDS.AX) may benefit from global supply tightness.

sectors.trend: Jetstar industrial action escalates; half of renters financially stressed; middle-income inequality widening. McDonald's navigating Ozempic demand shift. Chinese EV battery innovation (5-min charge) pressures local auto sector.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX faces operational disruption from Jetstar action. Consumer discretionary names under pressure. WES.AX, WBC.AX (Woolworths) face margin pressure from input costs and shifting consumer behaviour.

sectors.trend: Nine leadership reshuffle; Financial Review editor departs to media start-up. AI chip competition intensifies globally (Nvidia, AMD, Intel, Lumentum). Online safety law US intervention adds regulatory complexity.
sectors.implications: NEG.AX faces governance uncertainty. Limited direct ASX tech exposure but global AI capex cycle supports indirect demand. Monitor regulatory risk for digital platforms.

key_themes: RBA policy dilemma: hiking into recession risk vs. inflation credibility
AUD/USD weakness driven by US outperformance and Trump trade policy
Trump tariff/export ban spillover on Australian energy and trade
Property market correction: falling prices, rising listings, construction stress
Commodity exploration momentum (copper, gold, rare earths)
Fiscal sustainability: Intergenerational Report 2026 tax reform case
Energy security and cost-of-living political pressure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike into rising unemployment – stagflation risk
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive sectors (healthcare, staples); reduce leverage; hedge with gold and long-duration bonds selectively

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AUD/USD depreciation and Trump trade policy spillover
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners (BHP.AX, RIO.AX) that benefit from weaker AUD; avoid import-dependent consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply disruption from Trump diesel export ban and drying global buffers
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WES.AX, WDL.AX fuel cost exposure; favour LNG exporters; consider energy infrastructure plays

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Property market correction and construction sector stress (Bathla, rising listings)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; monitor bank NPL trends; favour established urban REITs over suburban/new-build

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Bond yield spike triggering equity de-rating
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration in growth/tech exposure; favour dividend-paying value; monitor 10-yr GSB yield as key trigger

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Jetstar industrial action and transport disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor QAN.AX; limited broad-market impact but watch tourism and consumer sentiment

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and copper exploration names on strong discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade intercepts (Auric Munda, Forrestania British Hill >210k oz, Sarytogan 452m copper) signal sector momentum; AUD weakness boosts AUD-denominated commodity returns

opportunities.recommendation: Favour large-cap diversified miners as AUD hedge
opportunities.rationale: Weaker AUD and global copper demand (Rio2 Peruvian drill) support BHP and Rio Tinto earnings; rare earths (Lindian) add strategic value

opportunities.recommendation: Add defensive healthcare and consumer staples exposure
opportunities.rationale: Stagflation risk and rate hikes favour low-beta, essential-demand sectors; CSL and Wesfarmers offer resilience

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and construction exposure; trim property-linked bank lending risk
defensive_moves.rationage: Falling property prices, rising listings, Bathla construction halts, and lender withdrawals signal sector stress; rising rates pressure REIT valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge equity portfolio against bond yield spike and AUD weakness
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX already slumping on yield spike; further hikes into unemployment risk could trigger broader de-rating; use gold and short-duration bonds as hedges

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid energy-intensive consumer and transport names amid fuel cost shock
defensive_moves.rationale: Trump diesel ban and drying buffers threaten fuel prices; Jetstar action adds operational risk; margin compression likely

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to remain under pressure from RBA hawkishness, bond yield volatility, AUD weakness, and energy cost fears. Unemployment at 5-year high creates stagflation narrative. Expect elevated volatility in ^AXJO and ^AORD. Mining and gold names may outperform on discovery news and AUD hedge.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive for commodity-exposed names if global demand holds. Structural fiscal concerns (Intergenerational Report) and energy transition (nuclear debate, EV adoption) create medium-term policy tailwinds for miners and energy infrastructure. Property correction may stabilise within 6-12 months. Key risk: Trump trade policy escalation.
